en.headline: Five plead guilty to $3.2m ParknShop warehouse ‘ghost worker’ fraud
en.dek: ICAC says former supermarket and contractor staff used a duplicate clocking machine to falsify attendance for 13 non-existent workers over two years; sentencing adjourned to March 2027.
body: Five former employees of supermarket chain ParknShop and its contractors pleaded guilty on Friday to conspiracy to defraud after an Independent Commission Against Corruption investigation found they had swindled more than HK$3.2 million in wage payments.

The defendants are Lau Kin-pong, 44, then a senior supervisor at ParknShop’s eCommercial Distribution Centre; Tai Kin-man, 43, then assistant manager of contractor Earnward Warehouse; and Wong Wai-fung, 27, Wong Pak-kan, 28 and Lau Tsz-pan, 28, then warehouse workers employed by another contractor, Logistics Network Management. They admitted one count of conspiracy to defraud at the District Court.

According to the ICAC, between June 2019 and April 2021 the group bought an identical clocking machine to the one used at the centre and fabricated attendance records for 13 Logistics Network workers who never worked there. Signatures were forged and the workers never received any of the wages. The defendants shared the proceeds with a sixth person, a former warehouse operations manager who has pleaded not guilty and faces trial in February 2027.
Judge Ernest Lin Kam-hung adjourned sentencing to 5 March 2027 and remanded the five in custody. ParknShop and the two contractors assisted the investigation, the ICAC said.

zh.headline: 百佳「鬼工」詐騙案五人認罪 涉款逾320萬
zh.dek: 廉署指前超市及承辦商職員用相同打卡機偽造13名從未上班工人的出勤紀錄，騙取工資逾320萬元；案件押後至明年3月判刑。
body: 五名前百佳超市及其承辦商職員周五在區域法院承認串謀詐騙罪，廉署調查發現他們在約兩年內以偽造出勤紀錄方式，騙取超過320萬元工資。
被告包括前百佳電子商務配送中心高級主管劉健邦（44歲）、前承辦商Earnward Warehouse助理經理戴健文（43歲），以及前另一承辦商Logistics Network Management倉庫工人黃偉峯（27歲）、黃柏勤（28歲）及劉子彬（28歲）。五人承認一項串謀詐騙罪名。
廉署指，2019年6月至2021年4月期間，五人購入與中心相同型號的打卡機，為13名從未在該中心工作的Logistics Network工人偽造出勤紀錄及簽名，令百佳發放工資，而工人從未收到任何款項。五人與另一名已否認控罪的前倉庫營運經理瓜分所得，該人將於2027年2月受審。
法官林錦雄將案件押後至2027年3月5日判刑，並還押五人於懲教署看管。百佳及兩家承辦商在調查期間全力協助廉署。
